tasks.completion_summary: Extended FilePIDTracker with descendant tree scanning: added DescendantPIDs/LastScanAt fields to TrackedProcess, background scanner goroutine (5s interval), DescendantTracker interface, ProcessManager integration (auto-start/stop scanner), enhanced CleanupOrphans and signalProcessGroup to use stored descendants, cross-platform support (Unix active scan, Windows no-op). All 13 new tests and all existing tests pass with race detector.

Added DOCTOR protocol verb with 9 concurrent health checks (orphan processes, port conflicts, daemon health, script health, proxy health, session health, config health, startup errors, process tree). Structured report with fix suggestions. Cross-platform pidAlive (Unix syscall.Kill, Windows OpenProcess). Client, ResilientClient, and MCP tool integration. 13 tests covering runner, timeout, session/startup/config/daemon checks.
